units.source_text: ……究竟那女人是怎么弄到这份报纸的呢？

en.t: ... How on earth had that woman managed to get hold of this newspaper?

units.source_text: ……大概村里的家伙，对他多少有些感到愧疚了吧？

en.t: ... Perhaps the people in the village had begun to feel at least a little guilty about what they had done to him?

units.source_text: ……即使如此，按以往的惯例，吃过早饭后，对外的一切联络都应该中断了呀。

en.t: ... Even so, according to the usual practice, all contact with the outside should have been cut off after breakfast.

units.source_text: 难道女人还有他所不知道的、与外界保持联系的方法吗，

en.t: Could the woman have some way of keeping in touch with the outside world that he did not know about,

units.source_text: 或者，是她自己外出买回来的吧，

en.t: or had she gone out herself and bought it,
those were the only possibilities left...
